1. Purpose
This policy defines the methodology used to measure the value of Order Intake for multi-element arrangements. This
version supersedes v1.0 and introduces a weighted allocation methodology following Q1 2025 internal audit
recommendations.
2. Scope
Applies to all multi-element customer arrangements combining:
- Hardware/Software (HW/SW) deliverables, AND
- Services deliverables
3. Definitions
Standalone Selling Price (SSP): The price at which the Company would sell a deliverable separately under similar
circumstances.
Weighted Factor: An adjustment factor applied per deliverable category to reflect margin and risk differences,
determined annually by the Pricing Committee.
4. Roles and Responsibilities
Role | Responsibility
Deal Desk | Prepares Relative SSP allocation calculations
Regional Finance Head | Reviews allocations exceeding threshold (elevated from Finance Manager)
Pricing Committee | Determines annual Weighted Factors
5. SSP Allocation Methodology
5.1 Calculation Basis
Allocation is performed using the Relative SSP method, under which a Weighted Factor is applied per deliverable
category. This replaces the unweighted Standalone List Price method used in v1.0.
5.2 Weighted Factor Determination
The Weighted Factor is determined annually by the Pricing Committee based on:
- Historical margin performance by deliverable category
- Delivery risk profile
- Market comparables
5.3 Allocation Formula
Step 1 — Relative SSP: Relative SSP = SSP × Weighted Factor
Step 2 — SSP Allocation: SSP Allocation = (Relative SSP ÷ Total Relative SSP) × Total Contract Value
Step 3 — Variance Check: SSP % from Contract Value = (SSP Allocation - Proportional Contract Value) ÷
Proportional Contract Value × 100

Note: Figures are illustrative and demonstrate the mechanics of Weighted Factor application; actual Weighted
Factors are published annually by the Pricing Committee.
7. Approval Requirements
Allocations resulting in variance greater than 10% from Relative SSP require Regional Finance Head sign-off prior to
booking.
CONTROL ENHANCEMENT
Threshold reduced from 20% to 10%; approval authority elevated from Finance Manager to Regional Finance
Head.
